history.availability: Source kickoff+7days strictly<target kickoff; exact outcome_available_utc equality; exact player/game/team/opponent/season/week/kickoff; source final-score presence reconstruction check. Actual provider finality/publication clocks unverified.

accounting.yards: finite signed; zero-carry/nonzero signed yards remain supported source facts and are included unchanged in pooled numerator with carry0; flags/counts retained, no fabricated carry or zero. Attribution to YPC is a modeling approximation. Only aggregate divisor must be positive.
